ai_summary.key_headline: Rangnick's Gegenpress Put to the Test Against Resilient Jordanians

austria.philosophy: High-intensity vertical press and immediate counter-pressing.

jordan.philosophy: Deep low-block with quick transitions through Al-Taamari.

tactical_insights: Austria's high press will aim to choke Jordan's build-up play in their defensive third.
Jordan will rely heavily on Musa Al-Taamari's individual dribbling to bypass Austria's initial press.
Sabitzer's late runs into the box will be key to unlocking Jordan's compact five-man defense.
